mod.biosphere.name: TOMC-Biosphere
mod.biosphere.description: A data-driven ecology simulation: predation, eating and random-tick succession.
text.autoconfig.biosphere.title: TOMC-Biosphere Config
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.passive: Loads biosphere_food_chain/*.json attack/avoid relationships. Changes apply after reloading the world.
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.environ: Loads biosphere_environmental_change/*.json succession rules. Changes apply after reloading the world.
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.spawnDa: Loads biosphere_spawns/spawns.json natural-spawn entries. Changes apply on next game start.
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.meleeDa: Damage dealt by the added melee attack.
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.meleeSp: Speed multiplier used when chasing relation targets.
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.meleeCo: Ticks between two melee attacks (20 ticks = 1 second).
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.avoidSp: Speed multiplier used when fleeing relation threats.
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.mushroo: Chance that a cow converts to a mooshroom after eating mycelium, in [0, 1].
text.autoconfig.biosphere.option.creefer: When false, the auto-detected creefern state is used. When true, forceOverride decides.
Only applies when override is true: true = force enable, false = force skip.
Read-only: true when creefern is detected at startup.
Creepers target mobs with current health above this value.
Creepers target mobs with current health at or below this value.
